title: pandas 3 support: text found in either string type, times without a year left missing, read-only arrays copied
request: The open edition caps pandas below 3; run the suite on pandas 3 and fix what breaks (owner: go on with what remains).
spec: pandas 3.0 release notes: the string dtype by default, copy-on-write (read-only arrays from to_numpy).
plan: Run the open tree's suite on pandas 3 (92 of 97 files passed).
Fix each cause once, in dclab_core where shared, so pandas 2 behaves as before.
Run the failing files on pandas 3 and pandas 2, then the full gate.

decisions.decision: One module, dclab_core.times, for is_text and read_times.
decisions.why: Nine places asked 'is it text' and ten parsed mixed times; one rule keeps them equal on both versions.

decisions.decision: A parsed time before the year 1000 is taken as one whose year was not written.
decisions.why: pandas 3's mixed parsing fills a missing year with 1; no real table has dates in year 1.

decisions.decision: Tests that asserted dtype == object now assert is_text.
decisions.why: What they check is that a column stayed text, not which type pandas uses for text.

change: dclab_core/times.py (new), datacard.py, analyse.py, leaves.py, anomaly.py (read_times, copies), dclab_rnd/draft/structure.py, studio/data.py, tools.py, kinds/embedded.py, general_pipeline/transformer.py (is_text), tests; dclab-core 0.100.1

findings.defect: Text columns were not recognised as text on pandas 3.
findings.scenario: A label column 'square'/'circle' sent to astype(int); a 'cash' column sent to float.
findings.cause: pandas 3 stores text in its string type, so dtype == object is False.

findings.defect: A syslog time without a year became a date in year 1.
findings.cause: pandas 3's format='mixed' fills a missing year with 1 where pandas 2 returned NaT.
findings.fix: read_times / without_yearless: values before 1000 made missing.

findings.defect: In-place changes to arrays from pandas failed.
findings.scenario: anomaly.split shuffling the index; datacard's quantiles; a test flipping labels.
findings.fix: to_numpy(copy=True) where the array is changed.

measurements.name: the 7 affected test files
limits: the affected files only; the whole suites are run next

outcome: The failing files pass on pandas 3 and pandas 2; the full suites decide whether the open edition's pandas<3 cap can go.
lessons: A dtype check is a claim about the library's version: ask what you mean (is it text?) through one helper.
A parser that changes from 'missing' to 'a guess' fails silently; test the missing case, not only the read one.
risks: Places that test dtype in other ways (select_dtypes, kind letters) were searched, but code paths without tests may still assume object.
